decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system is a multi-model line with its own page and fits the growing market for flexible workplaces, so its value is still unresolved and the option is worth keeping open.
The chair family sits close to the core offer and shares its production base, so keeping it costs little while its early market results remain uncertain.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory line, but they draw on existing rug materials and carry low holding costs, so the option stays open one more year.

The upholstered sofa is only mentioned on the website rather than given its own page, which suggests weaker emphasis, but it is close to the core business and cheap to keep while evidence accumulates.
The high standing table complements the office and conference range at low incremental cost, and one year of results is too little to justify abandoning it.
The rug collection is distant from the core offer and therefore highly uncertain, but it is presented as a strategic flagship, so management keeps this growth option open to learn its value.
